mekki-muskil:1-1.t: His saying, Exalted is He (إذا جاء نصر الله): the governing word (ʿāmil) in (إذا) is (جاء); its explanation has already preceded.

mekki-muskil:2-2.t:
His saying (يدخلون): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الناس), because (رأيت) is from seeing with the eye.
His saying (أفواجا): accusative as a ḥāl from the latent pronoun in (يدخلون), and that is what governs it. (أفواج) is the plural of «فوج», and its analogical [plural] is «أفواج», because the ḍamma is felt to be heavy on the wāw, so they likened «فَعْل» to «فِعْل» and pluralised it with the plural of ... [Translator's note: the text appears corrupt and incomplete here: «وقياسه أفواج» is presumably «وقياسه أفوُج» (its analogical plural would be «أفعُل»), and the final sentence breaks off after «جمع».]
